name: sureframe
description: Let Claude read your SureFrame clients, conversations, to-dos and notes to make reports. Read-only, and unlocked on your own computer.
long_description: Ask Claude about your SureFrame clients: who's waiting for an answer, which videos haven't been opened, what a client said, and what's due this week. Claude can only read, never send, change or delete. Your to-dos, notes, messages, replies and summaries are end-to-end encrypted: this connector unlocks them here on your computer with your team key, which Claude Desktop keeps in your computer's keychain. SureFrame's servers never see the key. What Claude reads goes to Anthropic under your own Claude account. Disconnect any time in SureFrame under Settings > Connections.
